versions.changelog:
Initial release of BMI Calculator:

- Calculates Body Mass Index (BMI) from height and weight.
- Supports both metric (cm/kg) and imperial (ft-in/lbs) units.
- Provides health category assessment (Underweight, Normal, Overweight, Obese).
- Calculates healthy weight range.
- Runs using pure Python standard library; no external dependencies needed.
